content:
Specify exact duration and structure the action as timestamped beats (e.g., [0:00-0:02], [0:02-0:05]) to control pacing and shot progression in Seedance.  
Direct camera behavior by explicitly instructing “starts mid action,” “different camera angle every cut,” and “fast cuts every half second” to enforce dynamic editing.  
Use contrast cues like “rhythm constantly alternates between slow precise strikes and explosive fast bursts” and “INTENSITY BUILDS” to drive motion cadence and escalation.  
Lock character/prop consistency by defining detailed CHARACTER and WOODEN DUMMY sections (appearance, clothing, object parts/materials) inside the prompt.  
Control audio by specifying instruments, when it starts (“frame one”), continuity (“never stopping”), dynamics (“building with intensity”), and layered SFX (“strike impact sounds layered on top throughout”).  
Upload reference images (character sheet + location sheet + prop reference) to anchor identity, environment, and key object design.  
Enforce a specific visual style by stacking render/style keywords (cinematic cel-shaded 3D anime, semi-realistic CGI, hand-painted textures, Unreal Engine quality, film grain, heavy shadows, hard-edge brushwork) and adding negative constraints (not cartoon, not Disney, not Pixar).

es.content:
Especifica la duración exacta y estructura la acción como beats con marca de tiempo (por ejemplo, [0:00-0:02], [0:02-0:05]) para controlar el ritmo y la progresión de planos en Seedance.  
Dirige el comportamiento de la cámara indicando explícitamente “starts mid action”, “different camera angle every cut” y “fast cuts every half second” para imponer una edición dinámica.  
Usa señales de contraste como “rhythm constantly alternates between slow precise strikes and explosive fast bursts” e “INTENSITY BUILDS” para impulsar el ritmo del movimiento y la escalada.  
Bloquea la consistencia del personaje/prop definiendo secciones detalladas de CHARACTER y WOODEN DUMMY (apariencia, vestimenta, partes/materiales del objeto) dentro del prompt.  
Controla el audio especificando instrumentos, cuándo comienza (“frame one”), continuidad (“never stopping”), dinámica (“building with intensity”) y SFX en capas (“strike impact sounds layered on top throughout”).  
Sube imágenes de referencia (character sheet + location sheet + prop reference) para anclar la identidad, el entorno y el diseño del objeto clave.  
Impón un estilo visual específico combinando palabras clave de render/estilo (cinematic cel-shaded 3D anime, semi-realistic CGI, hand-painted textures, Unreal Engine quality, film grain, heavy shadows, hard-edge brushwork) y añadiendo restricciones negativas (not cartoon, not Disney, not Pixar).

fr.content:
Spécifiez une durée exacte et structurez l’action en beats horodatés (par ex. [0:00-0:02], [0:02-0:05]) pour contrôler le rythme et la progression des plans dans Seedance.  
Dirigez le comportement de la caméra en indiquant explicitement « starts mid action », « different camera angle every cut » et « fast cuts every half second » afin d’imposer un montage dynamique.  
Utilisez des indices de contraste comme « rhythm constantly alternates between slow precise strikes and explosive fast bursts » et « INTENSITY BUILDS » pour guider la cadence du mouvement et la montée en intensité.  
Verrouillez la cohérence du personnage et des accessoires en définissant des sections détaillées CHARACTER et WOODEN DUMMY (apparence, vêtements, parties/matériaux de l’objet) à l’intérieur du prompt.  
Contrôlez l’audio en précisant les instruments, le moment où il commence (« frame one »), la continuité (« never stopping »), la dynamique (« building with intensity ») et les SFX superposés (« strike impact sounds layered on top throughout »).  
Téléversez des images de référence (character sheet + location sheet + prop reference) pour ancrer l’identité, l’environnement et le design de l’objet clé.  
Imposez un style visuel spécifique en empilant des mots-clés de rendu/style (cinematic cel-shaded 3D anime, semi-realistic CGI, hand-painted textures, Unreal Engine quality, film grain, heavy shadows, hard-edge brushwork) et en ajoutant des contraintes négatives (not cartoon, not Disney, not Pixar).

ja.content:
正確な尺を指定し、アクションをタイムスタンプ付きのビート（例: [0:00-0:02], [0:02-0:05]）で構成して、Seedanceでのテンポとショットの進行をコントロールします。  
“starts mid action”“different camera angle every cut”“fast cuts every half second”といった指示を明示的に与えてカメラの挙動を制御し、ダイナミックな編集を強制します。  
“rhythm constantly alternates between slow precise strikes and explosive fast bursts”や“INTENSITY BUILDS”のようなコントラストの手がかりを使って、動きのリズムと高まりを演出します。  
prompt内に詳細なCHARACTERセクションとWOODEN DUMMYセクション（外見、服装、オブジェクトの部位／素材）を定義して、キャラクターと小道具の一貫性を固定します。  
楽器、開始タイミング（“frame one”）、継続性（“never stopping”）、ダイナミクス（“building with intensity”）、重ねるSFX（“strike impact sounds layered on top throughout”）を指定して、音声を制御します。  
参照画像（character sheet + location sheet + prop reference）をアップロードして、アイデンティティ、環境、主要オブジェクトのデザインを固定します。  
レンダー／スタイルのキーワード（cinematic cel-shaded 3D anime, semi-realistic CGI, hand-painted textures, Unreal Engine quality, film grain, heavy shadows, hard-edge brushwork）を重ね、さらに否定条件（not cartoon, not Disney, not Pixar）を追加して、特定のビジュアルスタイルを強制します。

ko.content:
정확한 지속 시간을 지정하고, 동작을 타임스탬프가 표시된 비트로 구조화하세요(예: [0:00-0:02], [0:02-0:05]). 이렇게 하면 Seedance에서 페이싱과 샷 진행을 제어할 수 있습니다.  
카메라 동작은 “starts mid action”, “different camera angle every cut”, “fast cuts every half second”를 명시적으로 지시해 다이내믹한 편집을 강제하세요.  
“rhythm constantly alternates between slow precise strikes and explosive fast bursts”와 “INTENSITY BUILDS” 같은 대비 표현을 사용해 동작의 리듬과 고조를 이끌어내세요.  
프롬프트 안에 상세한 CHARACTER 및 WOODEN DUMMY 섹션(외형, 의상, 오브젝트의 부위/재질)을 정의해 캐릭터와 소품의 일관성을 고정하세요.  
오디오는 사용할 악기, 시작 시점(“frame one”), 연속성(“never stopping”), 다이내믹(“building with intensity”), 레이어드 SFX(“strike impact sounds layered on top throughout”)를 지정해 제어하세요.  
참조 이미지를 업로드해(캐릭터 시트 + 로케이션 시트 + 소품 레퍼런스) 정체성, 환경, 핵심 오브젝트 디자인을 고정하세요.  
렌더/스타일 키워드를 겹쳐 사용하고(cinematic cel-shaded 3D anime, semi-realistic CGI, hand-painted textures, Unreal Engine quality, film grain, heavy shadows, hard-edge brushwork), 부정 조건(not cartoon, not Disney, not Pixar)을 추가해 특정 비주얼 스타일을 강제하세요.

pt.content:
Especifique a duração exata e estruture a ação em batidas com marcação de tempo (por exemplo, [0:00-0:02], [0:02-0:05]) para controlar o ritmo e a progressão dos planos no Seedance.  
Direcione o comportamento da câmera instruindo explicitamente “starts mid action”, “different camera angle every cut” e “fast cuts every half second” para impor uma edição dinâmica.  
Use pistas de contraste como “rhythm constantly alternates between slow precise strikes and explosive fast bursts” e “INTENSITY BUILDS” para conduzir a cadência do movimento e a escalada.  
Trave a consistência do personagem/props definindo seções detalhadas de CHARACTER e WOODEN DUMMY (aparência, roupa, partes/materiais do objeto) dentro do prompt.  
Controle o áudio especificando instrumentos, quando ele começa (“frame one”), continuidade (“never stopping”), dinâmica (“building with intensity”) e SFX em camadas (“strike impact sounds layered on top throughout”).  
Envie imagens de referência (character sheet + location sheet + prop reference) para ancorar identidade, ambiente e o design do objeto principal.  
Imponha um estilo visual específico empilhando palavras-chave de render/style (cinematic cel-shaded 3D anime, semi-realistic CGI, hand-painted textures, Unreal Engine quality, film grain, heavy shadows, hard-edge brushwork) e adicionando restrições negativas (not cartoon, not Disney, not Pixar).

zh.content:
指定精确时长，并将动作结构化为带时间戳的节拍（例如：[0:00-0:02]、[0:02-0:05]），以控制 Seedance 中的节奏和镜头推进。  
通过明确指令“starts mid action”“different camera angle every cut”“fast cuts every half second”来直接控制镜头行为，以强化动态剪辑。  
使用对比性提示，如“rhythm constantly alternates between slow precise strikes and explosive fast bursts”和“INTENSITY BUILDS”，来驱动动作节奏与升级。  
通过在 prompt 内部定义详细的 CHARACTER 和 WOODEN DUMMY 部分（外观、服装、物体部件/材质），锁定角色/道具一致性。  
通过指定乐器、开始时间（“frame one”）、连续性（“never stopping”）、动态变化（“building with intensity”）以及分层音效（“strike impact sounds layered on top throughout”）来控制音频。  
上传参考图像（角色设定图 + 场景设定图 + 道具参考图），以锚定身份、环境和关键物体设计。  
通过叠加渲染/风格关键词（cinematic cel-shaded 3D anime, semi-realistic CGI, hand-painted textures, Unreal Engine quality, film grain, heavy shadows, hard-edge brushwork）并添加负向限制（not cartoon, not Disney, not Pixar），来强化特定视觉风格。
